summary.text: Colleen Garry is a Democratic state representative from Dracut who has represented the 36th Middlesex District since 1995 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney, she serves on the Joint Committees on Mental Health, Substance Use and Recovery; Public Service; State Administration and Regulatory Oversight; and the Judiciary.

paragraphs.text: Garry attended Dracut public schools, earned a B.S. from the University of Lowell, and received a J.D. from Suffolk University Law School.
She lists her profession as legislator and attorney and is a member of the Dracut Democratic Town Committee.
Garry has served in the Massachusetts House since 1995.
Her current committee assignments are the Joint Committees on Mental Health, Substance Use and Recovery; Public Service; State Administration and Regulatory Oversight; and the Judiciary.
